supersedes.scope: executable transport source binding and HTTP entity-coherence behavior only

new_behavior: H1 requires exactly one syntactically valid strong ETag in addition to the frozen length and range-support headers
every GET requires that exact H1 ETag before a connection is constructed
every GET sends the strong ETag in If-Match and requires the 206 response to repeat it exactly
missing, weak, malformed, duplicate, or changed ETags fail closed and cannot qualify a response
the retained receipt and command summary expose the validated response strong ETag

finding.disposition: prospectively correctable; not yet accepted by the evaluation owner
finding.statement: The prior route bound each response to one URL and length but did not bind its multiple ranges to one unchanged HTTP representation. A different same-length object could therefore be mixed into the sparse archive. Source d89748b requires strong-ETag coherence across H1 and every Range.

guarantee_boundary: A strong ETag supplies an HTTP representation-coherence witness only if the serving origin and intermediaries honor strong-validator and If-Match semantics. It is not a cryptographic content digest, publisher-authenticity proof, rights declaration, or verification of the unheld whole-wheel SHA-256.
contract_effect: Opus must prospectively accept or replace the strong-ETag H1 and Range rules together with the still-unresolved stop-on-redirect choice before dispatch
claim_boundary: transport conformance under injected responses only; live server validators and semantics remain unobserved
